comparisons.note: 情 and 忙 both use 忄 on the left. Compare 青 in 情 with 亡 in 忙.
情 and 请 both use 青 on the right. Compare 忄 in 情 with 讠 in 请.
Both have a reading qíng. Compare 情 (emotion, feeling, sentiment) and 晴 (clear / sunny).
